why: The 2026-06-14 single-ray return resolved compose (screen blend, alpha passthrough) and zero-ray handling, but the Strength=0 cases stay at max=113 because the Brightness Gain -> internal fd90 gain (param_10) transform is underdetermined.

At Strength=0 the seed is uniform (exponent -> 0 so seed = 1), so the output glow is a single constant per case. The only existing Strength=0 sample is Brightness Gain 9.4 -> uniform glow 0.498, which is one data point for a transform with unknown shape (linear? scaled? clamped?).

Two or more Strength=0 references at different Brightness Gain values pin the transform without PNG-fitting a constant. See notes/OLMKiraKira_ASM_FACTS.md (the [rbp+0x608] brightness arg into FUN_18114fd90).

inputs.description: Use the same source artwork as refs/win_references/20260604_olm/OLMKiraKira and the kirakira_single_ray_20260606 return so the constant is directly comparable.

cases.reason: Strength=0 low brightness anchor for the Brightness Gain -> param_10 transform.
Strength=0 mid brightness sample to test linearity vs clamping.
Strength=0 high brightness sample matching the existing 9.4 -> 0.498 point (confirm reproduction).

manifest_requirements: Record all OLM Kira Kira property names, match_names, property_index, values, enabled/active state, and selected effect path.
Record project_gpu_accel_type.current_name and raw value per render set.
Keep ADBE Force CPU GPU / GPU Rendering as reference-only metadata, not as the execution-path label.
Save both before_effects_frame and effect output PNG for every case.
CRITICAL: verify the number of exported PNGs equals the number of manifest cases (the 2026-06-14 render wrote a manifest but omitted PNGs for several requests).
Preserve the same comp size and source artwork used by the kirakira_single_ray_20260606 return.
mac_follow_up: Fit the Brightness Gain -> uniform-glow transform from the Strength=0 samples and set the OLMKiraKira fd90 param_10 mapping accordingly.
Re-measure the kirakira_single_ray Strength=0 cases (currently max=113) for exact(0).
